node.statement: Let epsilon_*:=epsilon_max^cb/2>0. Take B=A=C with their exact C*-algebra structures and v=id_C. At every matrix level the exact C*-identities satisfy all extended epsilon_*-C*-algebra inequalities (all error terms vanish and epsilon_*>=0), and id_C is a bijective extended 0-inclusion; since 0<=0<=delta_max^cb, lem-maincb-error-improvement applied to this admissible datum supplies a bijective extended (c0*epsilon_*)-inclusion v_tilde:C->C.
